# The go command names itself, one argv word per line, to every program it
# starts, so go/build inside a program it built lists packages through this
# go command when GOROOT holds none.

[short] skip 'builds and runs a program'

exec $GOROOT/bin/go run gocommand.go
stdout '^go(\.exe)?$'

-- go.mod --
module gocommand

go 1.27
-- gocommand.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	words := strings.Split(os.Getenv("GOCOMMAND"), "\n")
	fmt.Println(filepath.Base(words[0]))
}
